title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Copilot Search Matches on People's Department
description: Copilot Search can now match on a person's department, and you can find/lookup all people in a given department when searching the people source directly.
descriptionHtml: Copilot Search can now match on a person's department, and you can find/lookup all people in a given department when searching the people source directly.
